item.title: Indoor Infrared Heaters in Australia: What to Know Before You Buy
item.summary: Infrared heaters warm people and surfaces directly when they are in line of sight, much like the feeling of standing in sunshine. Unlike convective heaters that warm the air, radiant heat lands on whatever the heater points at.
